name: Al'tushka dlja skufa
source:
You don’t have a wife, you’re well over forty, your worldview is firmly formed, but there is no happiness in your life? Don’t worry, you just need to remember your Skoofuslugi password, and in a few clicks you can get your rightful alt girl!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2901520/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
既没讨到老婆，年纪早已年过四十，三观定型难以改变，生活里却找不到半点幸福？别发愁，只要想起来你的“大叔政务网”账号密码，动动手指点上几下，就能领到法定属于你的亚文化美少女啦！

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2901520/]Steam[/url]]
